ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.5). Adds a full-screen "Work Control" bottom tab laid out like the vanilla Work tab: one row per free colonist, a fixed pawn name column and a horizontal lane of compact two-line WorkType cards, with one shared horizontal scroll and one outer vertical scroll. Margins are tightened to about 4 px; cards are ~190x60. Each card shows the WorkType name (ellipsized, full name in tooltip) and the best relevant skill level with the vanilla minor/major passion icon. A pawn-name search box highlights matching rows only; clicking a row selects it visually, and double-clicking selects the pawn in game and moves the camera. A persisted per-save view mode (Draw / Manual / Both, default Both) is shown in the header and cycles on click; an "Open Work tab" button opens the vanilla Work tab without hiding either tab. Manual mode copies vanilla priorities at initialization instead of auto-recommending. Incapable WorkTypes stay out of the lane and stored order; the + picker lists remaining types with levels and shows incapable ones disabled as Incapaz. The colony initializes once at game start; resurrection and new colonists are handled, with capture guards that prevent partial vanilla states from overwriting stored orders. No profiles, schedules or equipment yet. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
